name: TechNova Fest
brief: Organise TechNova, a two-day college tech fest for about 1,500 students. It has a 24-hour hackathon, a robotics competition, three workshops and an evening concert. We need sponsors, venue and permissions, social media marketing, online registrations, stage, sound and lighting, food stalls, volunteers and security, and post-event accounts. Organising team of about eleven students; the fest should happen before the end-semester break, about nine weeks out.

tasks.name: Form core team and assign roles
Design branding, posters and social assets
Launch social media campaign and registration portal
Arrange food stalls, security and volunteer recruitment
Book sound, lighting and stage equipment
Set up online registration system and payment processing
Gather participant feedback and compile event metrics
Prepare final event report and documentation
Finalize financial accounts and archive records

risks.title: Venue permission delay
risks.cause: College administration takes longer than expected to approve the venue request
risks.event: Approval for the main hall is not received by the planned date
risks.effect: Securing the venue is delayed, pushing back equipment booking and setup schedule
risks.response: Submit the venue request with all required documents early and obtain a provisional written confirmation from the dean

risks.title: Insufficient sponsor funds
risks.cause: Key sponsors withdraw or reduce pledged amounts
risks.event: Expected sponsorship revenue falls short by 30%
risks.effect: Budget constraints force scaling back AV rentals and food stall arrangements
risks.response: Identify backup sponsors and create a tiered sponsorship package to attract additional small sponsors

risks.title: Registration portal technical failure
risks.cause: The online registration system experiences a server crash during the sign‑up period
risks.event: Students cannot complete registration or payment
risks.effect: Late registrations cause reduced participant numbers and delay final headcount for logistics
risks.response: Host the registration portal on a reliable cloud service with redundancy and conduct load testing before launch

risks.title: Low social media engagement
risks.cause: Marketing content does not resonate with the target student audience
risks.event: Social media campaign generates low reach and registrations
risks.effect: Participant numbers fall below target, affecting sponsor satisfaction and event atmosphere
risks.response: Perform a pilot test of posts, use student influencers, and adjust messaging based on early analytics

risks.title: Volunteer shortage
risks.cause: Many recruited volunteers have exam schedules overlapping with event days
risks.event: Only 60% of required volunteers are available
risks.effect: Volunteer training and shift coverage take longer, risking gaps during event execution
risks.response: Recruit 30% more volunteers than needed and create a backup pool of standby students

risks.title: Equipment delivery delay
risks.cause: AV supplier faces a transportation strike
risks.event: Sound, lighting and stage equipment arrive two days late
risks.effect: Setup time for concert and hackathon is compressed, increasing risk of technical glitches
risks.response: Include a penalty clause in the supplier contract and arrange a secondary local supplier as backup

risks.title: Scope creep – extra workshop added
risks.cause: Faculty proposes an additional high‑profile workshop after initial planning
risks.event: A fourth workshop is added without adjusting schedule
risks.effect: Venue and speaker bookings extend, pushing other tasks and increasing workload
risks.response: Lock the workshop count in the project charter and require senior approval for any additions

risks.title: Rainy weather affecting concert
risks.cause: Forecast predicts heavy rain on the evening of day 2
risks.effect: Concert may need to be moved indoors, requiring rapid re‑booking of space and equipment
risks.response: Secure an indoor backup venue and have rain‑proof tents ready as contingency

risks.title: Loss of participant feedback data
risks.cause: Feedback forms are stored on a local laptop without backup
risks.effect: Collected feedback and metrics are lost, hindering post‑event reporting
risks.response: Save feedback data to cloud storage in real time and back up daily

risks.title: Wi‑Fi security breach during hackathon
risks.cause: Weak Wi‑Fi network security allows unauthorized access
risks.event: External user interferes with participants' code submissions
risks.effect: Hackathon results are compromised and participants lose trust
risks.response: Implement WPA3 encryption, separate guest network, and monitor traffic with intrusion detection during the event
